{{Quote|Damn it, Krupo! I told you how precious my babies are to me, and you go and crash the ship with them in it!|Yarvok, about his pets|<ref name="Codex" />}}
'''Flappy''' was the name of one of [[Yarvok]]'s award-winning pet [[Xuvva]]. [[Krupo]], a beast wrangler, lost Flappy along with several of Yarvok's other pets after a ship carrying the pets crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], to Yarvok's anger. Yarvok threatened to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Krupo if his missing pets, including Flappy, were not found immediately.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Flappy was mentioned in the Codex entry for Invasive Species on Dantooine in the [[2019]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by the company [[BioWare]].<ref name="Codex" />
